thread:
Tom Park: Quick sync — proposing a hands-on playtest next Tue with SignalWorks to validate trace context handoff + dashboarding for GPU inference flows. Goal: end-to-end trace + logs + APM service map showing model->inference pool latency.
Maya Chen: love it. can we include span attrs for model_name, batch_size, seq_len, kv_cache_hit? those are critical for perf analysis.
Priya Kapoor: yes, and we should standardize the header we send through the proxy. currently our gateway strips traceparent for certain health routes.
Alex Rivera: noted. I'll add an opt-in passthrough flag in the proxy config. quick patch: `proxy.headers.preserve_trace = true` for routes `/v1/infer/*`.
Jamie Liu: SignalWorks side — they asked for an example OTLP config they can drop into their collector. they also want a sample Datadog query for correlating traces to logs.
SignalWorks Bot: onboarding doc prepared: https://internal.signalworks/example-otel-collector. they will test on their side Wed.
Tom Park: checklist I had in mind:
- agree on trace header mapping (traceparent / tracestate) and any custom baggage keys
- OTLP receiver config for dd-agent/collector on partner side
- Datadog Agent tags + APM service naming (service: redwood-inference, env: staging, model: <name>)
- dashboard tile spec (p50/p95 latency, tokens/s, GPU util, batch size distribution)
- sample prompt set to reproduce KV cache hits/misses

Maya Chen: example of custom span attributes we want attached (short):
```
model.name: "redwood-7b-v2"
batch.size: 8
seq.length: 512
kv_cache.hit: true
quantization: "gptq-4bit"
gpu.util_pct: 72.4
```

Alex Rivera: for OTLP -> Datadog exporter, SignalWorks recommended this minimal snippet for collector config:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "${DD_API_KEY}"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

Priya Kapoor: on the Datadog side, we'll need to set span sampling to keep model-inference spans (low cardinality for model.name helps). I'll add an index mapping rule to keep these tags.
Jamie Liu: for dashboards — recommend two boards: 1) service map + trace waterfall for tail latency debugging, 2) ops dashboard with GPU metrics and batch size histogram. I'll mock visuals.
Tom Park: runbook for the playtest (owners):
- Proxy passthrough flag + quick rollout (Alex)
- OTLP config + test tracer (SignalWorks / Jamie)
- Datadog agent tagging and sampling (Priya)
- Dashboard template + shared link (Maya)
- Validation script (curl + traceparent) and a short prompt set (Tom)

Maya Chen: validation script (curl example):
```
curl -i -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/infer \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-v2","prompt":"hello"}'
```

Tom Park: timeline: prep this week, partner tests Wed, internal playtest Tue next week, public demo Thurs (internal). sound ok?
Priya Kapoor: yes. I'll create the Datadog monitor drafts and share links.
Jamie Liu: I'll upload a sample dashboard JSON to the shared drive and ping here.
Alex Rivera: will open a small PR for proxy flag tonight. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:
SignalWorks Bot: test runner will push results to the channel once CI finishes.
dd-deploy-bot: Datadog agent updated in staging with new tag mapping at 2003123490.
Tom Park: perfect — thanks all. I'll assemble the playbook and post the checklist + links before EOD. :rocket:
